verdict.rationale: Lever exposes a REST API with documented endpoints (creating applications, OAuth, webhooks, audit events) covering core recruiting objects, but there's no evidence that API-exposed features achieve parity with UI-only capabilities like career-site building, AI form builder, AI interview transcripts/summaries, or analytics dashboard creation. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for AI features, career-site builder, analytics dashboards, and onboarding automation; any documentation or claim of full UI/API parity.
